actual: The committed Rotation L2 repository validates prediction_id as uuid.UUID and passes it directly to psycopg2. Against the authorized existing DEV database, the exact migration applied and schema verified, but the first 48,208-row import failed before any row commit with psycopg2.ProgrammingError: can't adapt type 'UUID'. Fix the HMM persistence boundary without changing the accepted zero-fit model contract, dataset, run identity, API semantics, or production/runtime state; add RED-to-GREEN coverage and preserve fail-closed/idempotent readback.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
